questions.q: What is Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications?
options: Oracle's modern, multi-tenant SaaS suite of business applications built on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
A single on-premises accounting program
A free add-on to Oracle E-Business Suite
A reporting tool that only works with non-Oracle databases
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications is Oracle's modern, multi-tenant SaaS suite, built from the ground up on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

questions.q: Which pillar does the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant career path focus on?
options: Oracle Fusion Cloud CX
Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP
Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM
Oracle Fusion Cloud EPM
questions.explain: This path focuses on the ERP pillar, specifically its Financials products: GL, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, and Subledger Accounting.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT one of the older Oracle product lines mentioned as still supported but not where Oracle invests its newest capabilities?
options: E-Business Suite
PeopleSoft
Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM
Siebel
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM is part of the modern Fusion Cloud suite itself — the older product lines are E-Business Suite, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, and Siebel.

questions.q: What does it mean that Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications is built on a 'unified data model'?
options: Each pillar keeps its own separate copy of customer and supplier data, synced nightly
Only the ERP pillar has any data at all
Data can only be entered through a single screen in the whole suite
The same underlying master data records, like customer or person, are shared across ERP, SCM, HCM, and CX
questions.explain: A unified data model means master data records are genuinely shared across pillars, not duplicated and connected by integration middleware.

questions.q: Does a company have to purchase every pillar of Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications?
options: No — a company can run Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP while using a different vendor for HR or CX
Yes, all five pillars are sold as one inseparable bundle
Only HCM and CX can be purchased together
Only the EPM pillar is optional
questions.explain: Pillars can be purchased independently — many customers run Fusion Cloud ERP for financials while using other vendors for HR or CX.
